MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink assortment fits my breadboards, relay module, and circuit board supplies because insulating wire connections is a practical next step in those projects.",
    "The caster set matches my recent interest in making furniture movable, although that interest does not mean I need another set now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The heavy battery lugs relate to electrical work, but my small circuit projects do not show a need for 4 AWG cable connectors.",
    "Cutting wheels, pocket-hole screws, and repair epoxies require specific jobs that my purchases do not establish.",
    "Eighteen rolls of duct tape are excessive for my occasional project needs, and another caster set would duplicate a recent purchase.",
    "Reclosable fasteners and surveillance stickers do not imply that I am decorating walls or repairing outdoor surfaces."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been treated as a broad interest in almost any workshop or repair supply, when the actual task matters much more to me.",
    "Electrical items seem to have been grouped together without enough attention to wire size and the difference between small circuits and heavy battery connections."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several of my purchases work together for small electronics assembly, making compatible wiring and insulation supplies more relevant than unrelated tools.",
    "My recent caster purchase may already satisfy that need; a useful complement is more appealing than another similar set.",
    "I choose supplies for concrete projects, so quantity and a clear use matter more than general DIY usefulness."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my practical project interests but stretched them too broadly beyond small electronics and needs I have not already filled."
}
